Yes, likely. Since the price dropped within 7 days of your purchase, you're eligible for the difference as Leafy store credit. This applies once per item and doesn't cover flash sales or clearance items.

If the item you bought was on flash sale or clearance, it wouldn't qualify. Can you share your order number (LF- plus six digits) and which item it was, so I can help get this started? The policy I have doesn't say how to submit the request, so if needed I can escalate it to a Support Lead.
